summary: Applied two spec-review repairs: cache path confinement for destructive self-heal and resolved tree consistency for metadata consumers.

items.title: Cache deletion target is not safely specified
items.target: R3 / T-2 dirty managed cache self-heal
items.rationale: Added explicit path confinement and unsafe source id rejection requirements before reset/clean/delete/reclone operations.
items.evidence: spec.json constraints[], requirements[R3].desc, acceptance_criteria[R3], overview.decisions[], and tasks[T-2] now require validating the cache path under .senti/plugin-sources/ before destructive operations.

items.title: Resolved tree consistency is not required for metadata consumers
items.rationale: Added an explicit requirement and acceptance criterion that metadata consumers inspect a tree matching the resolved commit.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[R7], acceptance_criteria[R7], overview.decisions[], tasks[T-1].acceptance, and tasks[T-4].acceptance now cover source root/materialized tree consistency.
